ns2:course.label: Rhetoric Tutorial
ns2:course.description: (RHET 100) Tutoring in writing skills to be scheduled by individual tutors. Open only to students placed in and registered for RHET 101 or RHET 102. May be repeated to a maximum of 2 hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Concurrent registration in RHET 101 or RHET 102.
